audience: event organizers who manage tickets and attendee check-ins with pretix

useCases.title: Review upcoming events and ticket availability
useCases.text: List upcoming events, inspect their ticket types and check the remaining quota before answering availability questions.

useCases.title: Find an order and its attendee tickets
useCases.text: Find orders by event or organizer, then inspect an order and its attendee tickets to answer booking questions.

useCases.title: Check attendance and waiting lists
useCases.text: Review check-in totals, attendee check-in history and waiting list entries for an event.

useCases.title: Check an attendee in or out
useCases.text: Find the attendee on a check-in list and record an entry or exit scan when requested. Pretix applies its ticket validation rules.
